Task: Text Content Safety

Write Python code that applies category thresholds to decide whether to allow text using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
```python
import os
from google.cloud import safety_content_v1

def filter_text_content(text: str, thresholds: dict) -> bool:
    """
    Evaluate text content safety using Google Cloud Safety Content API.
    
    Args:
        text (str): The input text to evaluate
        thresholds (dict): Category thresholds mapping category names to 
                          float values between 0 and 1
        
    Returns:
        bool: True if text is allowed (passes all thresholds), False otherwise
    """
    client = safety_content_v1.SafetyContentServiceClient()

    # Map category thresholds to API expected format
    category_threshold = {}
    for category, threshold in thresholds.items():
        category_enum = getattr(safety_content_v1.SafetyCategory, category.upper(), None)
        if category_enum is not None:
            category_threshold[category_enum] = threshold

    # Create the request
    request = safety_content_v1.ClassifyContentRequest(
        parent="projects/your-project-id/locations/global",
        item=safety_content_v1.Item(
            text=text
        ),
        category_threshold=category_threshold
    )

    # Send the request
    response = client.classify_content(request=request)

    # Check if any category exceeded its threshold
    for category in response.category_scores:
        category_name = safety_content_v1.SafetyCategory(category.name).name
        threshold = thresholds.get(category_name.lower(), 0.0)
        
        if category.score > threshold:
            return False
            
    return True
```
